title: Founding of Bagabag
description: On October 7, 1741, Padre Antonio del Campo founded the town at sitio Nagcumventuan, between what is now Pogonsino, Bagabag and Bangar, Solano, where a church was built at the original town site.

title: 2025–2028 Municipal Term
description: Voters elected Benigno B. Calauad as mayor and Nestor Sevillena as vice mayor for the 2025–2028 term, based on COMELEC Media Server results reported at 100% precincts.
